meta.title: Sign the petition: Stop Sky's ITV Takeover

meta.petitionHtml:
Petition text

Block the Sky takeover of ITV. The public wants you to protect the range of voices in the UK media. This deal cannot go ahead.

Why is this important?

Sky, owned by US media giant Comcast, wants to take over ITV. It would mean fewer and fewer voices reporting on the news here in the UK - as it would mean 86% of the UK news market being controlled by either the BBC or Sky. And it could pave the way for an end to ITV being free to watch here in the UK when its current licence ends in 2034.

We cannot allow more of our media landscape to become part of a monopoly controlled by a huge US company.

Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy has said she's thinking about intervening in the deal. But you can bet she'll be up against the lobbyists of this giant company, who'll be pressuring her and other politicians that the takeover should go ahead.

This whole situation is moving fast, so we need to move faster if we're going to drown them out and tell Lisa Nandy the public wants her to step in and protect our media.
